edges.reason: msg.sender selects the reward balance and is the transfer recipient before state is zeroed.
withdraw authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to hardcoded creator addresses.
The preSale whitelist gate is a long chain of msg.sender equality checks.
The mint recipient is _msgSender() forwarded to _safeMint.
Presale/sale admission depends entirely on miner-influenceable block.timestamp comparisons.
Price selection and whitelist bypass branch on block.timestamp >= saleStartTimestamp.
Withdrawal amount is read from and later cleared in the rewards mapping around an external transfer.
_draw credits rewards[ownerOf(winning_tiket)] += budget / tikets.
_draw obtains its pseudo-random seed from _getRandomNumber.
draw1 reads _state as its one-time execution guard.
The preSale modifier wraps and gates execution of mintTheHedgehog.
withdrawReward performs an external native transfer to msg.sender before zeroing its reward.
withdraw performs two native transfers to hardcoded addresses with no reentrancy guard.
Address.sendValue executes an arbitrary recipient call with value.
functionCallWithValue routes into the same value-bearing low-level call path.
_draw computes winning_tiket via seed shift/modulo and credits rewards by integer division.
mintTheHedgehog validates msg.value against prices chosen from block.timestamp.
withdraw gates payout on a msg.sender equality check against creator literals.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
numberOfNfts is multiplied by the selected price and added to totalSupply in supply checks.
newSaleStartTimestamp is written into saleStartTimestamp.
setSaleStartTimestamp mutates the saleStartTimestamp gate variable.
newPresaleStartTimestamp is written into presaleStartTimestamp.
setPresaleStartTimestamp mutates the presaleStartTimestamp gate variable.
newBaseURI is written into the baseURI metadata pointer.
setBaseURI mutates the baseURI state variable.
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner address.
The blockhash-derived seed feeds the winning ticket index computation.
tikets is the divisor in budget / tikets reward crediting.
start offsets the computed winning ticket index for each draw round.
The local balance copy of rewards[msg.sender] is transferred out before the mapping write.
The halved contract balance is the amount pushed by withdraw().
_safeMint invokes the recipient's onERC721Received callback, which can re-enter mint/transfer logic.
transferFrom delegates state mutation to _transfer after approval checks.
_transfer clears prior approvals through _approve.
_safeMint performs the state update through _mint before the receiver check.
draw1 advances the draw gate with _state <<= 1.
Mint pricing and whitelist bypass are both decided by block.timestamp values.
The reward transfer target and amount key are both derived from msg.sender.
withdraw payout is conditioned on msg.sender being one of two creator addresses.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() as the operator argument to the receiver callback.
safeTransferFrom ultimately reaches the receiver-check flow shared with safe minting.
